one_liner: Recall stops an agent's pending purchase when its evidence fails, then separately reviews a replacement before the buyer pays.
description: Agent purchases can outlive their supporting evidence. Recall makes a payment permit depend on an evidence-backed claim and a review window. A GenLayer Intelligent Contract evaluates pinned supplier terms against the buyer's rule, accepts counter-evidence, and re-evaluates the claim. The buyer can cancel an invalidated reservation without a refund because no payment has been sent. A replacement is a separate claim with its own review window; the original stays canceled. Our Studio test invalidated an EU-only inference offer after a binding amendment allowed US processing, canceled its 0.030 test-GEN permit, and verified a separate 0.040 test-GEN replacement transfer. The public walkthrough exposes documents, judgments and linked receipts without a wallet. A separate four-role flow lets users approve each transaction in their browser wallet. This is a sandbox prototype with fictional evidence and a preselected replacement, not autonomous procurement or production settlement.

how_to.heading: Inspect the original
how_to.instruction: Open the website without a wallet. Select Inference Basic. Expand the original order and binding amendment; compare the EU-only buyer rule with the amendment's US-processing allowance.

how_to.heading: Inspect the replacement
how_to.instruction: Select EU Dedicated Inference. Read its separate evidence and review outcome. Inspect the exact 0.040 test-GEN recipient, payment hash and finalized child transfer.

how_to.heading: Verify the record
how_to.instruction: Expand the transaction receipts, download the public run JSON, and inspect the contract in Studio. The view is a saved observation, not an ongoing network check. The repository includes the read-only verifier and offline tests.

how_to.heading: Optional fresh test
how_to.instruction: Use Try a new Studio run with four distinct accounts you control and test GEN only. Review every request before wallet approval. Follow DEMO.md. Do not attempt to repay the completed recorded permit.

expected_outcome: The original inference claim is INVALID and its permit CANCELLED, with no original payment. The replacement claim is VALID; its consumed permit is SCHEDULED. Its finalized payment links to a finalized 0.040 test-GEN transfer to the recorded seller. Eleven known receipts are supplied; the original reservation hash was not captured. This is a recorded GenLayer Studio sandbox result, not production settlement.
